ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISCHANGED(Refund_Status__c ) , ISPICKVAL( Refund_Status__c ,"Fully Refunded"), OR( ISBLANK( Repayment_Reference__c ) , ISBLANK( Repayment_Reason__c ), ISNULL( Date_Repayment_Made__c ), ISNULL( Date_Repayment_Requested__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill mandatory fields : Repayment Reference, Repayment Reason, Date Repayment Requested, Date Repayment Made
